entities.name: SCell Release Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for releasing Secondary Cells (SCells) based on sCellToReleaseList configuration.

entities.name: sCellToReleaseList
entities.description: List of SCell indexes to be released from UE configuration.

entities.name: sCellToAddModList
entities.description: List of SCell indexes to be added or modified in UE configuration.

entities.name: sCellIndex
entities.description: Identifier for a specific Secondary Cell.

entities.name: sCellState
entities.description: Indicates whether SCell should be in activated or deactivated state.

entities.name: SCell Activated State
entities.description: State where SCell is considered activated by lower layers.

entities.name: SCell Deactivated State
entities.description: State where SCell is considered deactivated by lower layers.

entities.name: SCell in current UE configuration
entities.description: Condition checking if SCell with given index exists in current UE configuration.

entities.name: Release SCell
entities.description: Action to release an SCell from UE configuration.

entities.name: Add SCell
entities.description: Action to add an SCell to UE configuration with common and dedicated configuration.

entities.name: Modify SCell
entities.description: Action to modify SCell configuration based on dedicated configuration.

relations.description: SCell release procedure uses sCellToReleaseList to determine which SCells to release.
SCell release procedure uses sCellToAddModList to determine which SCells to add or modify.
sCellToReleaseList contains sCellIndex values identifying SCells to release.
sCellToAddModList contains sCellIndex values identifying SCells to add or modify.
SCell release is guarded by condition that SCell exists in current UE configuration.
sCellState IE establishes SCell activated state when configured.
sCellState IE establishes SCell deactivated state when configured.
SCell addition procedure uses sCellState to configure activation state.
SCell modification procedure uses sCellState to configure activation state.
